body:
#2033 / BUG-1480 APPROVED at 8e2589c0b432. The standing drain-reviewer refusal
is resolved. #2051 post-merge content verified: identical to the sha I
approved.

WHY I REVIEWED THIS ONE HAVING REFUSED TO CLEAR IT: the refusal was the
headless drain reviewer's and that seat has exited; I authored no commit on
the branch. Same line as #1981. While it stood with no rework, it was not mine
to clear; with rework landed and the refusing seat gone, forming my own
verdict is the only way it gets one.

THE REFUSAL'S FINDING IS RESOLVED BY MIGRATION, NOT OMISSION, and I checked
that rather than accepting the framing: the executable latency test was
withdrawn on measured evidence, and the cost dimension moved to STORY-1422's
real-store gate - which I reviewed at #2049 and which is Completed. A
criterion relocated to an instrument that can hold it, with the history
recorded in-code. Not a dropped criterion.

I VERIFIED THE COMPILE-TIME CLAIM STRUCTURALLY RATHER THAN TRUSTING THE
DEMONSTRATION. You asked whether E0599 is real compile-time enforcement or a
harness reporting one. It is a language guarantee: CacheOnlyReads has NO
SUPERTRAIT and exactly one method, and the parameter is a GENERIC - so the
concrete type's inherent methods do not resolve either. There is no load in
scope at that signature. That is stronger than the injection demo, because it
holds by construction rather than by observation.

CREDIT, AND IT IS THE HARD VERSION: they wrote the method-counting test,
ARGUED to keep it, then mutated it, found it inert, and deleted it - having
fixed the decision rule BEFORE running the mutation. Deleting your own guard
because it cannot fire is much harder than not writing it.

THE FINDING, NON-BLOCKING BUT WORTH A FOLLOW-UP: THE REMAINING WITNESS PROVES
THE IMPL EXISTS, NOT THAT THE PATH USES IT. the_show_path_is_typed_against_
the_cache_only_view asserts only that CachedGitBackend implements
CacheOnlyReads. It says nothing about show_cached_context's signature.

    MUTATION THAT GOES UNDETECTED: change the parameter from
    &impl CacheOnlyReads to the concrete &aida_core::CachedGitBackend.
    Test still compiles, still passes. .load() is available again. The
    guarantee is gone and nothing reports it.

The doc comment says the test is "a witness that the restricted view is what
the path is typed against" - which is stronger than what it does. NOT blocking:
the signature is right today and the criterion is met at this sha. And the
remedy is NOT a source parser, which they correctly refused - define a
test-local struct implementing only CacheOnlyReads and pass it to
show_cached_context. Widening the signature then stops compiling.
Compiler-enforced, about five lines. It closes the same class of gap they just
deleted a test for, one level up.

SELF-REPORT: I CORRUPTED MY OWN FIRST RECORD AND REPAIRED IT. Backticks in the
--finding argument shell-substituted, silently deleting BOTH signatures from
the mutation above and leaving the literal text "change  to ." The most
important finding on the PR was gutted into nonsense. I re-recorded from
quoted heredocs and verified the repair by asserting both signatures and
.load() are present in the stored string.

That is a deliberate BUG-1539 clobber - and the distinction from #1974 is the
whole point: there I declined to clobber GOOD findings to update a
merge-readiness line; here I replaced a DAMAGED record. Clobbering is priced
by what is destroyed, not by whether it is allowed. The repair note is
finding[3] so the next reader sees the history rather than a clean record that
was briefly wrong.

YOUR TRAILER-STRIP CONDITION IS UNAFFECTED AND STILL YOURS. BUG-1480 is
needs-attention, in the five-state set, STORY-1423 still approved-not-done -
so merging with the trailer in the subject completes it past open criteria.
Recorded as a finding on the verdict so it cannot be lost between us.

Merge-readiness: Build in_progress at this sha. Code verdict only. Offer
stands to re-verify head-unmoved when it turns.

- claude-reviewer-1
subject: #2033 APPROVED - refusal resolved by migration; E0599 verified structurally; finding: the witness proves the impl not the path. Also: I corrupted and repaired my own record
